html.content:
Recommended

Stackedscore: 1.0

Stacked bars showing part-of-whole within each group.

Clinical use: AE severity breakdown per arm, disposition categories

  • 1 cat + numeric — possible stacked
  • few stack levels

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

This chart is ideal for showing the 'Value'

Alternatives

Boxplotscore: 0.9

Box-and-whisker showing median, IQR, and outliers per group.

Clinical use: Lab value distributions by arm/visit, PK endpoints

  • cat + numeric → distribution by group
  • sufficient n for box stats
  • multiple numeric vars

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='boxplot of <numeric> grouped by <factor>'

Scatter2Dscore: 0.9

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • colour by category
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

Linescore: 0.85

Connected points showing trends over a continuous or ordinal axis.

Clinical use: Lab values over visits, PK concentration-time profiles

  • colour by category
  • enough time points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='line chart of <numeric> over <time> colored by <factor>'

Ridgelinescore: 0.85

Stacked density plots per group — compare distributions without overlap.

Clinical use: Lab distributions across multiple visits or arms

  • cat + numeric → stacked densities
  • several groups to compare
  • 4+ groups → ridgeline avoids overlapping color curves

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ridgeline plot of <numeric> by <factor>'
